name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-angled-water-and-munchers
title: Super Mario World - Angled Water and Munchers
description:
Inspired by people saying that upside-down water is unrealistic, I made slanted water just for kicks. Muncher graphics for all orthogonal and diagonal directions are thrown in too.

Give credit please, as all but sideways munchers are handdrawn by myself.
